verses.original: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀ הַֽלְל֣וּ אֶת־ יְ֭הוָה מִן־ הַשָּׁמַ֑יִם הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ בַּמְּרוֹמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hal·lū yāh hal·lū ’eṯ- Yah·weh min- haš·šā·ma·yim hal·lū·hū bam·mə·rō·w·mîm
verses.literal: Hallelujah . . . Praise the LORD from the heavens praise Him in the highest places
verses.literalPt: LOUVAI ao SENHOR. Louvai ao SENHOR desde os céus, louvai-o nas alturas.

verses.original: הַֽלְל֥וּהוּ כָל־ מַלְאָכָ֑יו הַֽ֝לְל֗וּהוּ כָּל־ צְבָאוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hal·lū·hū ḵāl mal·’ā·ḵāw hal·lū·hū kāl- ṣə·ḇå̄·ʾō
verses.literal: Praise Him all His angels praise Him all His heavenly hosts
verses.literalPt: Louvai-o, todos os seus anjos; louvai-o, todos os seus exércitos.

verses.original: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ שֶׁ֣מֶשׁ וְיָרֵ֑חַ הַ֝לְל֗וּהוּ כָּל־ כּ֥וֹכְבֵי אֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: hal·lū·hū še·meš wə·yā·rê·aḥ hal·lū·hū kāl- kō·wḵ·ḇê ’ō·wr
verses.literal: Praise Him O sun and moon praise Him all you shining stars
verses.literalPt: Louvai-o, sol e lua; louvai-o, todas as estrelas luzentes.

verses.original: הַֽ֭לְלוּהוּ שְׁמֵ֣י הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְ֝הַמַּ֗יִם אֲשֶׁ֤ר׀ מֵעַ֬ל הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: hal·lū·hū šə·mê haš·šā·mā·yim wə·ham·ma·yim ’ă·šer mê·‘al haš·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: Praise Him O highest heavens . . . and you waters above the skies
verses.literalPt: Louvai-o, céus dos céus, e as águas que estão sobre os céus.

verses.original: יְֽ֭הַֽלְלוּ אֶת־ שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י ה֭וּא צִוָּ֣ה וְנִבְרָֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hal·lū ’eṯ- šêm Yah·weh kî hū ṣiw·wāh wə·niḇ·rā·’ū
verses.literal: Let them praise the name of the LORD for He gave the command and they were created
verses.literalPt: Louvem o nome do SENHOR, pois mandou, e logo foram criados.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲמִידֵ֣ם לָעַ֣ד לְעוֹלָ֑ם חָק־ נָ֝תַ֗ן וְלֹ֣א יַעֲבֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·mî·ḏêm lā·‘aḏ lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥāq- nā·ṯan wə·lō ya·‘ă·ḇō·wr
verses.literal: He established them forever and ever He issued a decree that will never pass away
verses.literalPt: E os confirmou eternamente para sempre, e lhes deu um decreto que não ultrapassarão.

verses.original: הַֽלְל֣וּ אֶת־ יְ֭הוָה מִן־ הָאָ֑רֶץ תַּ֝נִּינִ֗ים וְכָל־ תְּהֹמֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: hal·lū ’eṯ- Yah·weh min- hā·’ā·reṣ tan·nî·nîm wə·ḵāl tə·hō·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: Praise the LORD from the earth all great sea creatures and ocean depths
verses.literalPt: Louvai ao SENHOR desde a terra: vós, baleias, e todos os abismos;

verses.original: אֵ֣שׁ וּ֭בָרָד שֶׁ֣לֶג וְקִיט֑וֹר ר֥וּחַ סְ֝עָרָ֗ה עֹשָׂ֥ה דְבָרֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’êš ū·ḇā·rāḏ še·leḡ wə·qî·ṭō·wr rū·aḥ sə·‘ā·rāh ‘ō·śāh ḏə·ḇā·rōw
verses.literal: lightning and hail snow and clouds powerful wind fulfilling His word
verses.literalPt: Fogo e saraiva, neve e vapores, e vento tempestuoso que executa a sua palavra;

verses.original: הֶהָרִ֥ים וְכָל־ גְּבָע֑וֹת עֵ֥ץ פְּ֝רִ֗י וְכָל־ אֲרָזִֽים׃
verses.literal: mountains and all hills fruit trees and all cedars
verses.literalPt: Montes e todos os outeiros, árvores frutíferas e todos os cedros;

verses.original: הַֽחַיָּ֥ה וְכָל־ בְּהֵמָ֑ה רֶ֝֗מֶשׂ וְצִפּ֥וֹר כָּנָֽף׃
verses.transliteration: ha·ḥay·yāh wə·ḵāl bə·hê·māh re·meś wə·ṣip·pō·wr kā·nāp̄
verses.literal: wild animals and all cattle crawling creatures and flying birds
verses.literalPt: As feras e todos os gados, répteis e aves voadoras;

verses.original: מַלְכֵי־ אֶ֭רֶץ וְכָל־ לְאֻמִּ֑ים שָׂ֝רִ֗ים וְכָל־ שֹׁ֥פְטֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: mal·ḵê- ’e·reṣ wə·ḵāl lə·’um·mîm śā·rîm wə·ḵāl šō·p̄ə·ṭê ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: kings of the earth and all peoples princes and all rulers of the earth
verses.literalPt: Reis da terra e todos os povos, príncipes e todos os juízes da terra;

verses.original: בַּחוּרִ֥ים וְגַם־ בְּתוּל֑וֹת זְ֝קֵנִ֗ים עִם־ נְעָרִֽים׃
verses.literal: young men and maidens old and young together
verses.literalPt: Moços e moças, velhos e crianças.

verses.original: יְהַלְל֤וּ׀ אֶת־ שֵׁ֬ם יְהוָ֗ה כִּֽי־ נִשְׂגָּ֣ב שְׁמ֣וֹ לְבַדּ֑וֹ ה֝וֹד֗וֹ עַל־ אֶ֥רֶץ וְשָׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hal·lū ’eṯ- šêm Yah·weh kî- niś·gāḇ šə·mōw lə·ḇad·dōw hō·w·ḏōw ‘al- ’e·reṣ wə·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: Let them praise the name of the LORD for His name alone is exalted His splendor is above the earth and the heavens
verses.literalPt: Louvem o nome do SENHOR, pois só o seu nome é exaltado; a sua glória está sobre a terra e o céu.

verses.original: וַיָּ֤רֶם קֶ֨רֶן׀ לְעַמּ֡וֹ תְּהִלָּ֤ה לְֽכָל־ חֲסִידָ֗יו לִבְנֵ֣י יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל עַֽם־ קְרֹב֗וֹ הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·rem qe·ren lə·‘am·mōw tə·hil·lāh lə·ḵāl ḥă·sî·ḏāw liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl ‘am- qə·rō·ḇōw hal·lū- yāh
verses.literal: He has raised up a horn for His people the praise of all His saints of Israel . . . a people near to Him Hallelujah . . .
verses.literalPt: Ele também exalta o poder do seu povo, o louvor de todos os seus santos, dos filhos de Israel, um povo que lhe é chegado. Louvai ao SENHOR.
